purpose: Add immutable canonical derivation provenance so N0TE can explain where a version or asset came from, with explicit evidence/tool/provider/model/recipe/rights/consent/cost references and no invented certainty.

lineage.outcome: The artist can inspect a version and truthfully see represented source/derivation provenance without N0TE inventing rights, approval or causality.

completion_proof: VERSION and ASSET outputs accept immutable provenance records bound to their canonical Song
canonical VERSION/ASSET inputs must exist and belong to the same Song as the output
external inputs remain explicit references and are never promoted to canonical objects by inference
operation and evidence source are required while tool/provider/model/recipe/rights/consent/cost references remain optional
provenance writes append a PROVENANCE_RECORDED Activity event in the same successful transaction
Explain Version returns parent version, attached assets and represented derivation records after restart
missing provenance fields remain absent rather than guessed and provenance does not imply approval or rights certainty
provenance update/delete is rejected and tampered canonical references fail visibly
Explain Version is a pure read and inserts/updates/deletes zero rows
next_selection_rule: After CORE-01E proof, reconcile evidence and globally reselect from remaining CORE-01/customer work. Do not grow a generic graph by adjacency.
